name: evy
description: EVY monorepo - api, web, ios, services and shared types

scripts.dev:setup: docker compose up --wait postgres && bun run db:seed
scripts.dev: bun run types:generate && bun run dev:setup && bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error dev:postgres:logs dev:api dev:web dev:marketplace dev:watch
scripts.format: bunx biome check --write . && bun run --cwd api format && bun run --cwd web format && bun run --cwd services/marketplace format && xcrun swift-format format --in-place --recursive ios
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd api && bun install --cwd web && bun install --cwd services/marketplace
